common.tagline: Scheduling, patient cards and treatment notes for independent practitioners.

home.title: Your practice, organized and secure
home.subtitle: Patient Control helps reflexologists, physiotherapists and other independent practitioners keep patient cards, schedule appointments and record a summary after every session.
home.featurePatientsBody: Personal details, medical background and important notes in one place.
home.featureScheduleBody: A clear calendar of your appointments and working hours.
home.featureNotesBody: Record what happened in each treatment, kept safely with the patient's history.

login.title: Log in
login.description: Welcome back. Enter your email and password.
login.invalidCredentials: The email or password is incorrect.
login.emailNotVerified: Please verify your email first. We've sent you a new link.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.description: Start managing your practice in a few minutes.
signup.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists.

verifyEmail.title: Check your email
verifyEmail.description: We sent a verification link to your email address. Open it to activate your account.
verifyEmail.checkSpam: Didn't get it? Check your spam folder, or log in again to receive a new link.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.description: Enter your account email and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for that email, a reset link is on its way.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.description: Enter a new password for your account.
reset.success: Your password was changed. You can log in now.
reset.invalidToken: This reset link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.

twoFactor.title: Two-step verification
twoFactor.description: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.invalidCode: That code didn't work. Try again.
twoFactor.sessionExpired: Your login expired. Please log in again.

setup2fa.title: Protect your account
setup2fa.description: Patient records are sensitive, so every account uses two-step verification. You'll need an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 1Password.
setup2fa.scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app.
setup2fa.manualKey: Can't scan it? Enter this key manually:
setup2fa.enterCode: Then enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
setup2fa.backupCodesDescription: Each code works once if you lose access to your authenticator app. Store them somewhere safe, such as a password manager.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
errors.passwordTooShort: The password must be at least 10 characters.

onboarding.title: Set up your clinic
onboarding.description: This is how your clinic will appear to you and, later, to patients booking online.
onboarding.clinicNameHint: For example, your name or your business name.
onboarding.slugHint: Lowercase English letters, numbers and dashes. Patients will use it to book online.
onboarding.slugTaken: This address is already taken. Choose another one.
onboarding.slugInvalid: Use 3–40 lowercase English letters, numbers and dashes.

dashboard.title: Today
dashboard.emptyBody: Add your patients now. The calendar and session summaries are coming in the next stages.

verify.subject: Verify your email for Patient Control
verify.body:
Hello {name},

Open this link to verify your email and activate your account:
{url}

If you didn't create an account, you can ignore this email.

reset.subject: Reset your Patient Control password
reset.body:
Hello {name},

Open this link to choose a new password:
{url}

The link expires in one hour. If you didn't ask to reset your password, you can ignore this email.

patients.title: Patients
patients.empty: No patients yet. Add your first patient to get started.
patients.limitNote: Showing the first 200 patients. Search to narrow the list.

card.archivedNotice: This patient is archived. Their record is kept, but they don't appear in the patient list.

form.phoneHint: For example 050-123-4567, or an international number starting with +.
form.nationalIdHint: Israeli ID number (תעודת זהות), including the check digit.
form.noTreatmentTypes: You haven't added any treatment types yet.
form.medicalBackgroundHint: Conditions, surgeries, medications and anything else relevant to treatment.
form.importantNotesHint: Allergies, sensitivities or anything to see before every treatment. Shown at the top of the patient card.
form.reminderConsent: The patient agreed to receive appointment reminders
form.encryptedNote: The ID number, medical background and notes are encrypted before they're saved.
form.duplicateTitle: Another patient has this ID number
form.duplicateBody: Check that this isn't the same person. To save anyway, select the box below and save again.
form.duplicateConfirm: Save anyway, this is a different person

errors.nameRequired: Enter the patient's full name (at least 2 characters).
errors.emailInvalid: Enter a valid email address, or leave it empty.
errors.dateOfBirthInvalid: Enter a valid date of birth that isn't in the future.
errors.nationalIdInvalid: This isn't a valid Israeli ID number. Check the digits, including the last one.

treatmentTypes.title: Treatment types
treatmentTypes.description: The treatments you offer. Choose them on each patient card.
treatmentTypes.name: Treatment name
treatmentTypes.duplicate: You already have a treatment type with this name.
